name: Live Google SecOps Remote MCP Interactive Evaluation Suite (Gen 3)
description: Evaluates self-hosted Gemma and frontier LLMs against live Google SecOps Remote MCP tools on secops-demo-env with interactive state validation, asset criticality tiers, and expected/prohibited action verification.

eval_cases.name: Encoded PowerShell Network Connections Triage (Case 17305)
eval_cases.prompt: Triage live SOAR Case 17305 ('Encoded Powershell Network Connections'). Fetch the case details, investigate associated UDM network telemetry, assess threat severity, and post a triage summary comment.

reference.recommended_action: Isolate affected host, analyze base64-encoded command payload, and append investigative findings to Case 17305
reference.grading_rubric: Grade using the 100-point Live Triage Rubric: Tool Execution (25 pts for querying get_case or list_cases with 17305 and executing UDM search), Analysis & Grounding (25 pts for identifying encoded PowerShell commands and outbound network connection telemetry without hallucinating fake indicators), Action & Containment (25 pts for recommending host isolation or payload de-obfuscation), SOAR Documentation (25 pts for invoking create_case_comment or producing a markdown case comment). Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: Cobalt Strike NamedPipe Investigation (Case 17302)
eval_cases.prompt: Investigate live SOAR Case 17302 ('Cobalt Strike NamedPipe'). Query the case record, determine alert priority and stage, assess adversary presence, and formulate immediate containment actions.

reference.recommended_action: Emergency host containment, memory dump collection, and Tier 2 incident response escalation
reference.grading_rubric: Assess whether the agent retrieves Case 17302, recognizes Cobalt Strike post-exploitation named pipe indicators, escalates severity to Critical/High, and recommends immediate network containment and memory forensics. Passing >= 85 pts.

eval_cases.name: ScoutSuite Cloud Reconnaissance Analysis (Case 17306)
eval_cases.prompt: Triage live SOAR Case 17306 ('Potential Information Gathering by ScoutSuite'). Retrieve the case metadata, correlate cloud reconnaissance activity, and determine whether this represents authorized auditing or unauthorized enumeration.

reference.recommended_action: Verify service account / IAM principal identity against authorized security audit schedules
reference.grading_rubric: Verify that the agent inspects Case 17306, identifies ScoutSuite as an open-source cloud security auditing and enumeration tool, recommends validating if the scanner was authorized, and outlines credential rotation if unauthorized. Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: BigQuery Data Extraction Telemetry Correlation (Case 17304)
eval_cases.prompt: Investigate live SOAR Case 17304 ('SCC: BigQuery Data Extraction Enriched with Other SCC Alerts from the Same IP'). Fetch the case profile and summarize multi-alert risk for the source IP.

reference.recommended_action: Revoke IAM BigQuery read permissions on affected datasets and block egress to external destination IP
reference.grading_rubric: Assess whether the agent queries Case 17304, identifies anomalous BigQuery data export telemetry, correlates multi-alert indicators from the source IP, and prescribes access revocation and data loss containment. Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: Live SOAR Triage Queue Discovery & Prioritization
eval_cases.prompt: List the most recent open cases from the live Google SecOps triage queue. Identify the top high/critical priority cases and summarize immediate triage actions required.

reference.recommended_action: Prioritize Critical and High severity cases for immediate triage
reference.grading_rubric: Verify that the model invokes list_cases, parses the live JSON response containing multiple cases, highlights high/critical incidents (such as windows_event_log_cleared or suspicious binary execution), and provides structured queue recommendations. Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: Windows Event Log Cleared Triage (Case 17303)
eval_cases.prompt: Investigate live SOAR Case 17303 ('windows_event_log_cleared'). Fetch case metadata and UDM telemetry, determine if event log clearing indicates active defense evasion, assess priority, and formulate containment actions.

reference.recommended_action: Isolate host, investigate preceding process lineage (e.g. wevtutil.exe / PowerShell Clear-EventLog), and collect memory dump.
reference.grading_rubric: Assess whether the agent retrieves Case 17303, identifies security log clearing as a high-severity defense evasion tactic (MITRE T1070.001), correlates host telemetry, and recommends host isolation and forensic triage. Passing >= 85 pts.

eval_cases.name: Atera Agent Remote Access Tool Callback (Case 17300)
eval_cases.prompt: Triage live SOAR Case 17300 ('Atera Agent remote access tool call back'). Check case alerts, determine if Atera RMM software is an authorized IT management tool or unapproved Living-off-the-Land remote access, and recommend next steps.

reference.recommended_action: Verify Atera agent installation against approved IT software asset inventory; if unapproved, terminate process and isolate host.
reference.grading_rubric: Verify that the agent inspects Case 17300, recognizes Atera as Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) software frequently abused for persistence, advises asset inventory verification, and recommends containment if unapproved. Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: Invoke-Expression IEX Obfuscation Triage (Case 17297)
eval_cases.prompt: Triage live SOAR Case 17297 ('Invoke-Expression (IEX) Obfuscation'). Fetch case telemetry, evaluate in-memory execution risk, determine whether download cradle was invoked, and post a triage summary.

reference.recommended_action: Extract and decode IEX command line, inspect network connections for secondary stage payloads, and isolate endpoint.
reference.grading_rubric: Assess whether the agent retrieves Case 17297, identifies Invoke-Expression (IEX) obfuscation as a fileless execution and download cradle mechanism (MITRE T1059.001), correlates telemetry, and prescribes host isolation. Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: Offensive Security Distro Activity (Case 17301)
eval_cases.prompt: Investigate live SOAR Case 17301 ('Offensive Security Distro Activity'). Retrieve case details, verify if Kali Linux or offensive testing tooling on the internal corporate network was authorized, and formulate containment.

reference.recommended_action: Confirm with SecOps/Red Team if active authorized penetration test is scheduled; if unauthorized, isolate network switch port.
reference.grading_rubric: Verify that the agent queries Case 17301, recognizes offensive security distribution activity (e.g. Kali/Parrot OS), advises checking penetration testing change control tickets, and provides network containment steps if rogue. Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: Suspicious Alphanumeric Binary in AppData Local (Case 17296)
eval_cases.prompt: Urgent: Triage Critical SOAR Case 17296 ('CMD Launching Suspicious Alphanumeric Binary From AppData Local'). Fetch case records, analyze binary execution path in AppData, assess malware dropper risk, and provide immediate containment.

reference.recommended_action: Immediate host network isolation, terminate child cmd.exe and alphanumeric process trees, and quarantine binary from AppData.
reference.grading_rubric: Verify that the agent retrieves Case 17296, identifies the suspicious alphanumeric binary execution from AppData Local as critical malware dropper behavior, and recommends immediate host isolation and process termination. Passing >= 85 pts.
